title: Several Random Variables
intro: Most questions involve more than one random quantity at once. Joint distributions describe them together; marginals, conditionals, covariance and conditional expectation extract what you need.

items: Joint Distributions (#/probability/multivariate/joint-distributions): joint PMFs and densities, marginals, conditionals and independence of random variables.
Covariance and Correlation (#/probability/multivariate/covariance-and-correlation): how two variables move together, the variance of a sum, and covariance matrices.
Conditional Expectation (#/probability/multivariate/conditional-expectation): E[Y | X] as a random variable, the laws of total expectation and variance, and best prediction.
Sums of Random Variables (#/probability/multivariate/sums): convolution, and which families are closed under addition.
The Multivariate Normal (#/probability/multivariate/multivariate-normal): the Gaussian vector, its linear algebra and its conditionals.
J. K. Blitzstein and J. Hwang, Introduction to Probability, 2nd edition, CRC Press (2019), chapters 7 and 9
G. R. Grimmett and D. R. Stirzaker, Probability and Random Processes, 4th edition, Oxford University Press (2020), chapters 3 and 4
